description: This script updates CSV files used as references in CI for PyTorch's Dynamo/Inductor, focusing on graph breaks. It queries GitHub workflows, downloads artifacts, extracts CSVs, filters and merges data, and applies linter patches.

methods.name: query_job_sha
methods.description: Queries GitHub workflow jobs for a specific commit SHA and repository.

methods.name: get_artifacts_urls
methods.description: Generates URLs for artifacts based on workflow results, suite names, and whether it's ROCm or CUDA.

methods.name: download_single_artifact
methods.description: Downloads and extracts CSV data from a single artifact zip, trying multiple URLs.

methods.name: download_artifacts_and_extract_csvs
methods.description: Downloads multiple artifacts in parallel and aggregates CSV data.

methods.name: write_filtered_csvs
methods.description: Merges new CSV data with existing files, sorts, writes, and applies linter patches.

methods.name: apply_lints
methods.description: Runs a linter script on CSV files and applies any suggested patches.
